notes: New Sky page (in Mine): the roof radio on SatPi. Auto mode tracks planes overhead on a live map and switches itself to the Meteor weather satellites for each good pass, then back. The Satellite tab shows the next pass as a sky dome (where it rises, how high, where it sets) with a countdown, a 24-hour pass timeline, and the picture gallery. Viewing needs the new Sky permission; changing the radio mode is admins only.
